SELECT B.AC_NAME AS PartyNameL,A.AC_CODE AS AcCodeL,A.VCH_NO AS VchNoT,replace(convert(NVARCHAR,A.VCH_DATE, 103), ' ', '/') AS RepDtL,A.IT_NAME AS ItNameL,A.ITM_GWT As ItmGwtW,A.SR_NO As SrNoM,A.CO_YEAR AS YearL,A.CO_BOOK as BookL,A.HD_VCH_NO As HdVchNoL,A.REP_AC_NAME AS CustNameL FROM REP_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_CODE = B.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.ISU_ADJ = 'N' AND A.AC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.BOOK_NAME = 'KRREP ISSUE' ORDER BY A.VCH_DATE,A.VCH_NO

Select A.TAG_NO,A.VCH_SRNO,B.VCH_DATE FROM MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN BAR_DETL AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.TAG_NO = B.TAG_NO AND A.VCH_SRNO = B.VCH_SRNO WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.TAG_NO = ' ? ' ? AND A.VCH_SRNO = ? AND B.EMP_ISU <> 'Y' GROUP BY A.TAG_NO,A.VCH_SRNO,B.VCH_DATE HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN ='+' THEN A.VCH_SRNO ELSE - A.VCH_SRNO END) > 0 ORDER BY B.VCH_DATE DESC

Select A.TAG_NO AS TagNoL,B.IT_NAME As ItNameL,A.IT_CODE as ItCodeL,C.DESIGN_NO AS DesignNoL,C.ITM_GWT AS GrWtW,C.ITM_NWT AS NetWtW,C.ITM_MRP as MrpR,C.VCH_SRNO,C.VCH_DATE From (MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN BAR_DETL AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.TAG_NO = C.TAG_NO AND A.VCH_SRNO = C.VCH_SRNO)LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND C.EMP_ISU <> 'Y' GROUP BY A.TAG_NO,B.IT_NAME,A.IT_CODE,C.DESIGN_NO,C.ITM_GWT,C.ITM_NWT,C.ITM_MRP,C.VCH_SRNO,C.VCH_DATE HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.VCH_SRNO ELSE -A.VCH_SRNO END) > 0 ORDER BY A.TAG_NO,C.VCH_DATE DESC
